It started with The Secret—the book everyone was talking about. With promises of manifestation, positive energy, and the power of the mind, the law of attraction seemed like the key to happiness. Even Oprah and Ellen promoted it as life-changing.

But for today’s guest, following The Secret didn’t lead to peace—it led straight into the heart of the New Age movement. Crystals, energy work, and spiritual “truths” that turned out to be anything but.

In this powerful testimony, hear how the law of attraction opened doors to deception—and how Jesus Christ revealed the truth that finally set him free.
